title: Portal CV template
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y10 lessons 4, 12 (Portal CV template)
intro: Lesson 4: CVs and personal statements. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Section
What I will write
rows: Name and contact details (email only; no home address on a draft)

keywords.def: curriculum vitae: a summary of your education, skills and experience
a short paragraph about who you are and what you offer
someone who can confirm your character

questions.a: 'I built a Python quiz program and help my family with online forms.'

questions.q: Draft your CV (portal template): personal statement, education, three skills with evidence, experience or volunteering.
questions.a: A one-page draft CV; teacher feedback in the portal.

questions.q: Extend: ask a parent to proofread and note two improvements.

options: 'Led a team of 4 to run a charity stall raising £150'
questions.a: A) 'Led a team of 4 to run a charity stall raising £150'. Specific, evidenced and measurable.

questions.q: Think again: An employer spends about 30 seconds on a CV. What would make them read yours properly?
questions.a: A clear layout, relevant skills with evidence, no errors and an honest, specific statement.
